name: Rings scUSD
oneLiner: scUSD is Rings' wrapper minted from supported stablecoins routed through Veda BoringVault DeFi strategies; yield is activated by staking into stkscUSD.
collateral: Stablecoin deposits routed through Trevee (formerly Rings) / Veda BoringVault infrastructure into curated DeFi lending strategies (e.g. Aave, Morpho); supported collateral includes USDC, USDT, DAI, GHO, and Sonic USDC.e
pegMechanism: Users deposit supported stablecoins to mint scUSD and redeem scAssets after a documented cooldown period; yield is primarily activated by staking scUSD into stkscUSD rather than by holding liquid scUSD itself.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: scUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

notices.title: On-chain reserve tracking pending
notices.message: Live reserve tracking for scUSD is pending Rings publishing canonical BoringVault and treasury backing addresses. Check https://docs.rings.money/backing for the latest published addresses.

mintAuthority.summary: scUSD is a Veda BoringVault receipt token: users deposit accepted stablecoins to mint scUSD shares via a Teller, but the BoringVault role set (minter/teller/solver/queue) is administered under a 4/6 Veda/Paladin governance multisig with role-based timelocks, making the privileged surface a concentrated admin.

controls.label: Veda/Paladin governance multisig (BoringVault role admin)
controls.evidence: LlamaRisk review states Rings governance uses 4/6 multisigs managed by Veda and Paladin contributors, with role-based timelocks controlling each BoringVault contract set and some EOAs administering the BoringOnChainQueue and BoringSolver.

controls.label: Veda BoringVault Teller (scUSD share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: scUSD is a BoringVault receipt token minted by the Teller when supported stablecoins are deposited; share issuance is deposit-driven but the minter/teller roles are granted under the governance multisig.

review.evidence: Veda and Rings docs plus the LlamaRisk security review describe scUSD as a Veda BoringVault receipt token minted on stablecoin deposit, with a 4/6 Veda/Paladin governance multisig and role-based timelocks controlling the minter/teller/solver/queue contract set; canonical backing addresses are not yet fully published.
review.sourceFreeRationale: 4/6 multisig and BoringVault role architecture taken from the LlamaRisk review and Veda/Rings docs; the exact governance multisig address, timelock delays, and module/guard status were not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain Rings governance multisig address and role-timelock delays, and the published BoringVault/treasury backing addresses.
